text:
kevin: Heads up — ap-northeast-3 GPU pool is flapping after the overnight NACL tighten + role-boundary rollout. Seeing repeated node drains during bootstrap.
lina: Confirmed. ~22% of boots fail with keystore decrypt errors then kubelet drain.
omar: Redacted log:
```
ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: ExplicitDeny kms:Decrypt (role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/edge-bootstrap)
 at bootstrap/keystore.go:142
```
kevin: We applied a NACL rule to reduce ephemeral port range for provisioning and the compliance job applied a role boundary that enforces `aws:PrincipalTag:team=infra`. Suspect interplay.
infra-bot: alert: gpu-pool-ap-northeast-3 underprovisioned (desired 200 -> ready 155).
omar: Packet captures show SYN, SYN-ACK, then a sudden RST from the NAT gateway when client source port is outside the new allowed ephemeral range. That aborts TLS handshake mid-KMS call and sometimes SDK surfaces as AccessDenied when retry context lost.
lina: Packet snippet: `tcp 10.5.2.14:32779 -> keystore-proxy.ap-northeast-3:443 RST` — and TCP state shows conn closed after 1s.
kevin: Impact: autoscaler is launching nodes in eu-central-2 to compensate -> cross-region egress and prewarm. Cost watch triggered. @cost-ops FYI.
cost-ops: Noted. Current extrapolation ~3.1k/hr if it remains degraded for >1h. Escalate if >4k/hr.
compliance: The role-boundary rollout included an explicit deny for principals without `team` tag to prevent lateral dev access. edge-bootstrap role should have that tag but may not have been propagated to some instance profiles. I'll audit roles now.
omar: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert NACL ephemeral restriction 2) temporarily add NAT port mapping to allow old ephemeral range 3) add exception in endpoint policy for edge-bootstrap role. Preferred: 1 then 3 if needed.
lina: Revert NACL then run 200 canary boots: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS https://orchestrator/simulate-boot -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-3"}'; done` and tail keystore logs.
kevin: I'll coordinate with infra to flip NACL in 8m and monitor for 15m. If role tag propagation is the root cause we still need a follow-up fix.
infra-bot: NACL change scheduled at 03:40 UTC. Will post status.
compliance: Found 7 instance profiles missing `team=infra` tag due to an older provisioning template. I'll open a rollout to tag those roles and add a policy unit test to the role-boundary generator.
kevin: Deployed NACL revert at 03:42 UTC. Immediate metrics: ready nodes climbed 155 -> 198 over 5 minutes. Canaries show keystore decrypt success.
lina: Good recovery. We'll keep canaries running for 30m and schedule a proper role-tag roll for the missing profiles.
omar: Follow-ups: - Add integration test that simulates ephemeral port truncation + KMS handshake recovery - Add mapping check to role-boundary generator to ensure bootstrap roles are exempt or tagged - Put a cost guard that pauses non-critical cross-region prewarms when region readiness <80%.
cost-ops: Will add cost alert threshold and notify PG if we hit 2k cumulative.
kevin: TL;DR: NACL ephemeral port restriction + missing role tag -> interrupted KMS boot calls -> node evictions -> cross-region cost. Reverted NACL, tagging rollout in progress. Logs/captures: s3://redwood-debug/ap-northeast-3/3442109876-nacl-keystore-pcap.pcap
infra-bot: monitoring: 15m stable window started.
kevin: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
